text: The paragraph contributes to the plot's development by establishing the inciting incident and the central conflict of the narrative. The opening rhetorical question serves as a narrative hook, while the subsequent action of the spaceship entering the wormhole marks the transition from the known world to the unknown. The discovery of an advanced, life-filled galaxy acts as the catalyst for the story, shifting the focus from survival during travel to the consequences of first contact. This event sets up the dual thematic stakes of the plot: the potential for unprecedented cooperation versus the looming threat of intergalactic conflict, thereby defining the primary tension that will drive the narrative forward.
